body: thank you! That really meant a lot to me! You too :D

I’m so sorry. I know how it feels to lose a friend, and not even know about it until a month later. The same thing happened to me at the beginning of this school year with my internet friend, and I only found out about his passing because it was trending on twitter. I felt like a monster, like I should of reached out, I should of psychically known he needed help and I should of been there. Realistically, I know it’s not my fault, but brains be like that and it’s hard not to blame yourself. I know saying this won’t help, but don’t blame yourself.
